import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Derivation.repr
C0_dependencies.content:
protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)

    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ

  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ

  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

C0_dependencies.content:
protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=

      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem

    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := cut dp dn

def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b
annotation: def provableOfDerivable {φ} (b : T ⟹. φ) : T ⊢ φ := b

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Derivation.binductionOn
C0_dependencies.content:
inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"

      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>

      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>

      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"

    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

instance : Tait.Cut (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  cut {_ _ _ dp dn} := by exact?

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ

  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)

    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=

def em {Δ : Sequent L} : {φ : SyntacticFormula L} → (hpos : φ ∈ Δ) → (hneg : ∼φ ∈ Δ) → T ⟹ Δ
  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

instance : Tait (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) where
  verum := fun _ Δ => verum Δ
  and := fun dp dq => dp.and dq
  or := fun d => d.or
  wk := fun d ss => d.wk ss
  em := fun hp hn => em hp hn

| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

  | axL _ _ _   => 0

  | root _      => 0

  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++

      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"

      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"

      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  | φ ⋎ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free φ) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hneg) (by rfl))
    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=
      Derivation.cast this (by simp[←TransitiveRewriting.comp_app])
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem

    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)
  termination_by φ => φ.complexity

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

  | ⊤,         hpos, hneg => verum' hpos
  | ⊥,         hpos, hneg => verum' hneg
  | .rel R v,  hpos, hneg => axL' R v hpos hneg
  | .nrel R v, hpos, hneg => axL' R v hneg hpos
  | φ ⋏ ψ,     hpos, hneg =>
    have ihp : T ⟹ φ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ψ :: ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ ∼φ :: ∼ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp[hpos])
    this.or.wk (by simpa using hneg)

    have ihp : T ⟹ ∼φ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have ihq : T ⟹ ∼ψ :: φ :: ψ :: Δ := em (φ := ψ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ := (ihp.and ihq).wk (by simp [by simpa using hneg])
    this.or.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∀' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (∼Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=

    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk

    this.all.wk (by simp[hpos])
  | ∃' φ,      hpos, hneg =>
    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ := em (φ := Rewriting.free φ) (by simp) (by simp)
    have : T ⟹ (Rewriting.shift φ)/[&0] :: ∼Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺ :=

    have : T ⟹ Rewriting.free (∼φ) :: Δ⁺ := (ex &0 this).wk
      (List.cons_subset_of_subset_of_mem
        (List.mem_cons_of_mem (free (∼φ)) <| by simpa using mem_shifts_iff.mpr hpos) (by simp))
    this.all.wk (by simpa using hneg)

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max n m + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

@[simp] lemma ne_step_max' (n m : ℕ) : n ≠ max m n + 1 :=
  ne_of_lt $ Nat.lt_succ_of_le $ by simp

private lemma neg_ne_and {φ ψ : SyntacticFormula L} : ¬∼φ = φ ⋏ ψ :=
  ne_of_ne_complexity (by simp)

| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)

    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

def axL' {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v)
    (h : Semiformula.rel r v ∈ Δ) (hn : Semiformula.nrel r v ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (axL Δ r v).wk (by simp[h, hn])

def all' {φ} (h : ∀' φ ∈ Δ) (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : T ⟹ Δ := d.all.wk (by simp [h])

def ex' {φ} (h : ∃' φ ∈ Δ) (t) (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (d.ex t).wk (by simp [h])

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ

  | all d       => d.length.succ

  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

C0_dependencies.name: LO.FirstOrder.Derivation.repr
C0_dependencies.content:
protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>

  | root _      => 0

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

  | verum _     => 0

  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ

      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"

  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++

  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"

      Derivation.repr dp ++

      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ

| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)

| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

@[simp] lemma length_all {φ} (d : T ⟹ Rewriting.free φ :: Δ⁺) : length (all d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_ex {t} {φ} (d : T ⟹ φ/[t] :: Δ) : length (ex t d) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_wk (d : T ⟹ Δ) (h : Δ ⊆ Γ) : length (wk d h) = d.length.succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cut {φ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dn : T ⟹ (∼φ) :: Δ) :
  length (cut dp dn) = (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ := rfl

end length

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

@[simp] lemma length_cast' (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (e ▸ d) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

alias weakening := wk

def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

                                                     h : Membership.mem Δ Top.top
                                                     ⊢ HasSubset.Subset (List.cons Top.top Δ) Δ
                                                   -/
def verum' (h : ⊤ ∈ Δ) : T ⟹ Δ := (verum Δ).wk (by simp[h])

  | axL _ _ _   => 0

  | root _      => 0

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

section Repr
variable [∀ k, ToString (L.Func k)] [∀ k, ToString (L.Rel k)]

protected unsafe def repr {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → String
  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

unsafe instance : Repr (T ⟹ Δ) where reprPrec d _ := Derivation.repr d

end Repr

protected abbrev cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) : T ⟹ Γ := e ▸ d

@[simp] lemma cast_eq (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Δ) : Derivation.cast d e = d := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_cast (d : T ⟹ Δ) (e : Δ = Γ) :
    length (Derivation.cast d e) = length d := by rcases e with rfl; simp[Derivation.cast]

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0

  | all d       => d.length.succ

  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

C1_dependencies.name: rfl
C1_dependencies.content:
/--
`rfl : a = a` is the unique constructor of the equality type. This is the
same as `Eq.refl` except that it takes `a` implicitly instead of explicitly.

This is a more powerful theorem than it may appear at first, because although
the statement of the theorem is `a = a`, Lean will allow anything that is
definitionally equal to that type. So, for instance, `2 + 2 = 4` is proven in
Lean by `rfl`, because both sides are the same up to definitional equality.
-/
@[match_pattern] def rfl {α : Sort u} {a : α} : Eq a a := Eq.refl a

  | axL Δ _ _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(axL)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | verum Δ       =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\top$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @or _ _ Δ φ ψ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\lor$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋎ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @and _ _ Δ φ ψ dp dq =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dq ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\land$)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((φ ⋏ ψ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @all _ _ Δ φ d       =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\forall$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∀' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @ex _ _ Δ φ _ d      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize($\\exists$)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr ((∃' φ) :: Δ) ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @wk _ _ _ Γ d _      =>
      Derivation.repr d ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(wk)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Γ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | @cut _ _ Δ _ dp dn =>
      Derivation.repr dp ++
      Derivation.repr dn ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(Cut)}\n" ++
      "\\BinaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr Δ ++ "$}\n\n"
  | root (φ := φ) _   =>
      "\\AxiomC{}\n" ++
      "\\RightLabel{\\scriptsize(ROOT)}\n" ++
      "\\UnaryInfC{$" ++ reprStr φ ++ ", " ++ reprStr (∼φ) ++ "$}\n\n"

import Foundation.Logic.Calculus
import Foundation.FirstOrder.Basic.Syntax.Rew

namespace LO

namespace FirstOrder

abbrev Sequent (L : Language) := List (SyntacticFormula L)

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}

inductive Derivation (T : Theory L) : Sequent L → Type _
| axL (Γ) {k} (r : L.Rel k) (v) : Derivation T (rel r v :: nrel r v :: Γ)
| verum (Γ)    : Derivation T (⊤ :: Γ)
| or {Γ φ ψ}   : Derivation T (φ :: ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋎ ψ :: Γ)
| and {Γ φ ψ}  : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (ψ :: Γ) → Derivation T (φ ⋏ ψ :: Γ)
| all {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (Rewriting.free φ :: Γ⁺) → Derivation T ((∀' φ) :: Γ)
| ex {Γ φ} (t) : Derivation T (φ/[t] :: Γ) → Derivation T ((∃' φ) :: Γ)
| wk {Γ Δ}     : Derivation T Δ → Δ ⊆ Γ → Derivation T Γ
| cut {Γ φ}    : Derivation T (φ :: Γ) → Derivation T (∼φ :: Γ) → Derivation T Γ
| root {φ}     : φ ∈ T → Derivation T [φ]

instance : OneSided (SyntacticFormula L) (Theory L) := ⟨Derivation⟩

abbrev Derivation₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Type _ := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹ Γ

abbrev Derivable₀ (Γ : Sequent L) : Prop := (∅ : Theory L) ⟹! Γ

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ " => Derivation₀

prefix:45 "⊢ᵀ! " => Derivable₀

namespace Derivation

variable {T U : Theory L} {Δ Δ₁ Δ₂ Γ : Sequent L} {φ ψ r : SyntacticFormula L}

open Rewriting LawfulSyntacticRewriting

def length {Δ : Sequent L} : T ⟹ Δ → ℕ
  | axL _ _ _   => 0
  | verum _     => 0
  | or d        => d.length.succ
  | and dp dq   => (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ
  | all d       => d.length.succ
  | ex _ d      => d.length.succ
  | wk d _      => d.length.succ
  | cut dp dn   => (max (length dp) (length dn)).succ
  | root _      => 0

section length

@[simp] lemma length_axL {k} {r : L.Rel k} {v} :
  length (axL (T := T) Δ r v) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_verum : length (verum (T := T) Δ) = 0 := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_and {φ ψ} (dp : T ⟹ φ :: Δ) (dq : T ⟹ ψ :: Δ) :
    length (and dp dq) = (max (length dp) (length dq)).succ := rfl

@[simp] lemma length_or {φ ψ} (d : T ⟹ φ :: ψ :: Δ) : length (or d) = d.length.succ := rfl

namespace LO

open Semiformula
variable {L : Language} {T : Theory L}
